subject: general
question: Which of the following showed an increase to 99.62% in 2024-25, according to the Sustainable Development Goals – National Indicator Framework Progress Report, 2025?

options.text: Percentage of population using an improved drinking water source in rural areas
The renewable energy share in the total installed electricity generation
Percentage of population covered by social protection systems/floors
The reduction in emissions intensity of GDP

solution:
The correct answer is __**Percentage of population using an improved drinking water source in rural areas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Sustainable Development Goals – National Indicator Framework (NIF) Progress Report, 2025**, the **Percentage of population using an improved drinking water source in rural areas** has shown a significant increase, reaching **99.62%** in the **2024-25** period.
 
• This indicator is a crucial component of **SDG Goal 6**, which aims to ensure the availability and sustainable management of **water and sanitation** for all.
 
• The data reflects the massive progress made under the **Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)**, which was launched to provide **Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC)** to every rural household in **India**.
 
• The **National Indicator Framework (NIF)** is the backbone of monitoring **SDGs** in India, developed by the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** to track the progress of global goals through a localized lens.
